reforms.description: The Government is implementing initiatives to promote innovative activities in Canada, including support for the development of environmental technologies, reforming the unemployment-insurance system, enhancing job training, supporting small businesses, and promoting technological innovation.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: These initiatives are designed to enhance innovation and support small businesses, which are expected to contribute positively to economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The measures have been actively put into practice as part of the government's initiatives.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reforms represent a significant overhaul of the unemployment insurance system and a strong push towards innovation and job training.
reforms.source_quote: The new Government has taken measures to reform the unemployment-insurance system, enhance job training, support small businesses, and promote technological innovation.

reforms.description: The Labour Force Development Board was created in 1991 to enhance private sector involvement in UI-sponsored training and developmental programmes, reflecting a significant policy shift towards active labour market measures.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: By enhancing private sector involvement in training, the initiative aims to improve workforce skills and employability, contributing to economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The board has been actively functioning since its establishment.
reforms.importance_rationale: The establishment of the board represents a significant but narrower reform focused on training and development.
reforms.source_quote: The Labour Force Development Board was created in 1991 to provide a mechanism for private sector involvement in UI-sponsored training and other developmental programmes.
